title: Modern Linear-Style Project Kanban Board
description: Tablero Kanban para gestión de proyectos con 4 columnas (Backlog, En Progreso, En Revisión, Completado), etiquetas de prioridad y modales de tarea rápida.
prompt:
Create a responsive, Linear-inspired Kanban Board component in React + Tailwind CSS.

### 1. Board Header & Filters
- Board Title: "Sprint 34 — AI Model Integration".
- Quick Filters: "My Issues", "High Priority", "Unassigned", "Blocked".
- Search box + "+ New Issue" action button.

### 2. Columns (4 Columns):
1. Backlog (Count: 8)
2. In Progress (Count: 4)
3. In Review (Count: 3)
4. Done (Count: 14)

### 3. Task Card Structure:
- Priority indicator icon (Urgent red flame, High orange chevron, Medium yellow line, Low blue dot).
- Issue ID in font-mono (e.g., "ENG-402").
- Task Title: Clear, 2-line clamp.
- Tag pills (e.g., "Frontend", "Auth", "API", "Bug").
- Subtasks progress: e.g., "3/5 subtasks" with a mini progress bar.
- Footer: Due date badge + Assignee avatar (or "+" button if unassigned).

### 4. Micro-interactions:
- Hovering over a card shows a subtle lift effect (-translate-y-1) and brightens border from 8% to 20% opacity.
- Empty column state with "+ Add card" dashed placeholder.

- Right: Page navigation (Previous, 1, 2, 3, ..., Next) with rows per page selector (10, 25, 50).

title: Stories in Light
description: A moody photographer-portfolio hero where the cursor becomes a spotlight gliding over a portrait to unveil a hidden gold Venetian mask and the damask wallpaper beneath the dark, one soft oval of light at a time.
prompt:
Canvas & base: Full-viewport hero section, exactly 100vh tall, overflow: hidden, position: relative. Base background color #2b3342 (dark slate blue-grey). All text #f0f0ee (warm off-white). Body margin 0, page background #2b3342. Links #f3f2f2, hover #ffffff, underline offset 3px. Font: Archivo (grotesque sans), used for everything. Zero border radius everywhere except the two pill/circle elements noted below. No shadows, no glassmorphism, no scroll animations.

Background image stack (4 absolute layers, all inset: 0, width/height: 100%, object-fit: cover, object-position: center, GPU-composited via transform: translateZ(0)):

Clean portrait — https://cdn.sceneai.art/Bg%20images/ddfc017a-6d87-42c8-b9d6-c068c2854910.png. A dark, moody studio portrait: a man's face centered in frame, even soft frontal lighting, skin natural and unadorned, surrounded by a deep desaturated dark backdrop with subtle ornamental texture. Low-key cinematic grade, muted shadows, no motion. draggable: false, user-select: none.
Gold layer at 10% — same-size duplicate of https://cdn.sceneai.art/Bg%20images/27a6b99b-8093-439e-be9c-1c96311e8fb8.png: the identical portrait/composition but the face wears an ornate gold filigree mask and the backdrop carries a rich gold damask/ornamental pattern; warm metallic highlights, luxury-campaign lighting. Static at opacity: 0.1, pointer-events: none.
Gold reveal layer — the same gold image again at full resolution, default opacity: 0, transition: opacity 0.4s ease-out, will-change: opacity, pointer-events: none, clipped by a CSS mask: mask-image: radial-gradient(closest-side, #000 62%, transparent 100%), mask-repeat: no-repeat, mask-size: 110px 140px (soft-feathered vertical oval).
Scrim — linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(20,24,32,0.55) 0%, rgba(20,24,32,0.12) 45%, rgba(20,24,32,0.6) 100%), pointer-events: none.
Cursor-reveal interaction (desktop only — gate with matchMedia('(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)'); touch devices show the static state): mousemove on the hero records target cursor coordinates relative to the section. A single requestAnimationFrame loop lerps current position toward target at factor 0.22 per frame; each frame sets the reveal layer's mask-position to (x − 55px, y − 70px) so the oval stays centered on the gliding point. First movement snaps position and sets reveal opacity to 1. The one oval simultaneously unveils the gold mask over the face and the 100%-opacity damask over the background — one continuous spotlight over the 10% base. On mouseleave, opacity returns to 0 via the 0.4s ease-out transition, restoring clean face + 10% pattern. Never autoplays; no canvas; loop stops when settled (delta < 0.3px).

Content overlay (position: relative; z-index: 3; height: 100%; display: flex; flex-direction: column; padding: 44px 64px 40px; pointer-events: none):

Top bar: display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: baseline, 16px, weight 500, letter-spacing 0.02em. Left group (flex, gap 28px): "faruq®" and "visual archive". Center: "©2026" in a pill — border: 1.5px solid #f0f0ee; border-radius: 999px; padding: 4px 20px; font-size: 15px. Right group (flex, gap 14px): "(", "long exposure", "/", "low light", ")".
Headline (margin-top 40px): font-size: clamp(52px, 7.4vw, 104px); font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: -0.02em; line-height: 0.98, lowercase, flush left. Line 1: "stories in light". Line 2: an inline-flex row (gap 24px) of a circled "+" glyph (0.8em square, 1.5px solid #f0f0ee border, border-radius: 50%, centered "+" at 0.45em, weight 400) followed by "motion".
Bottom row (margin-top: auto; display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: flex-end; gap: 48px): Left — "night work only", 18px, weight 500, line-height 1.45. Right block (max-width: 560px) — justified paragraph, 15.5px, line-height 1.6, word-spacing 0.15em: "slow shutters, moving light. i make short visual stories after dark — where motion becomes the subject and light does the drawing. no studio, no staging: just time, left open long enough to leave a trace." Below it (margin-top 20px, flex space-between, 14px, letter-spacing 0.02em): "selected work — vol.01" left, "( scroll ↓ )" right.
Hierarchy: oversized lowercase headline dominates; thin editorial metadata at top and bottom edges; imagery carries the drama; the only "animation" on the page is the cursor spotlight. All copy lowercase, flush left, no buttons, no nav links, no emoji, no gradients besides the scrim.

description: Kova app onboarding two mobile screens with cinematic video backgrounds and purple-gradient CTAs.
prompt:
Design Prompt — "Kova" Dual Mobile Onboarding Screens (pixel-fidelity recreation)

Layout container: flexbox row, gap: 40px, align-items: center, justify-content: center, padding: 40px, min-height: 100vh — both phones perfectly centered. Typeface: -apple-system / "SF Pro Text" / Helvetica Neue stack throughout. Default link color #ffffff, hover #e9d5ff.

Phone shells (both): 300×650px, border-radius 44px, overflow hidden, background #000000, white text, flex column. Each contains a full-bleed background video, absolutely positioned (inset 0, 100%×100%, object-fit: cover), autoplaying, looping, muted, playsInline, with JS that every 800ms re-mutes and calls .play() on any paused video so autoplay never stalls.

Screen 1 video: https://cdn.sceneai.art/Background%20Videos/1d917612-01e5-49cf-a2f7-4bf518790efd.mp4
Screen 2 video: https://cdn.sceneai.art/Background%20Videos/22ea08d0-2933-4a84-8fb6-f90557a306d8.mp4
Above each video sits a readability scrim (absolute, inset 0): screen 1 — linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 50%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 80%, rgba(0,0,0,0.75) 100%); screen 2 — linear-gradient(180deg, transparent 45%, rgba(0,0,0,0.55) 75%, rgba(0,0,0,0.78) 100%). All content is position: relative so it stacks above video and scrim. A flexible spacer pushes everything to the bottom of each screen.

Screen 1 — Welcome. Bottom-anchored content:

Headline "Turn your ideas into cinematic scenes" — 24px, weight 500, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing −0.3px, centered, white, side padding 30px.
CTA container: full width, padding 28px 24px 26px.
Button "Start creating" — full-width, 56px tall, border-radius 16px, no border, background linear-gradient(120deg, #ffffff 0%, #e9d5ff 55%, #c084fc 100%) (white → lavender → light purple), text #2e1065 (deep violet), 13px, weight 600, centered; hover brightens 5%.
Screen 2 — Style picker onboarding. Bottom-anchored column, centered items, gap 14px, padding 0 24px 26px:

Headline "Every scene, styled the way you imagine" — identical type to screen 1 (24px, weight 500, line-height 1.3, letter-spacing −0.3px, centered, white); wraps to two lines at this width.
Subtitle "Pick a style, drop a prompt, and Kova renders the rest." — 14px, line-height 1.45, centered, #f5f5f4, max-width 230px.
Button row (flex, gap 12px, full width, margin-top 8px), both 52px tall, border-radius 16px, no border, 13px weight 600, equal flex widths:
"Explore styles": background linear-gradient(120deg, #ffffff, #d8b4fe), text #2e1065; hover brightness 1.1.
"Join Kova": background linear-gradient(120deg, #8b5cf6, #6d28d9) (violet), white text; hover brightness 1.15.
Link "Already with Kova? Log in" — 12px, weight 500, white, no underline, margin-top 4px, centered.
Hierarchy & behavior: No status bars, no nav. The only motion is the looping background videos — no scroll animation; the page is a static centered composition. Fixed phone dimensions (not responsive); the outer flex container centers them at any viewport size. Corners: phones 44px, all buttons 16px, nothing else rounded. No shadows or borders anywhere; the scrims are the only overlays. Visual hierarchy per screen: video imagery → headline → (subtitle) → gradient CTA(s) → small text link.

title: Aesthetic Onboarding
prompt:
Create a modern, high-end login screen in React using Tailwind CSS and Lucide React icons. The layout should have a dark, immersive theme with a frosted glass card overlay.

### 1. Global Background
- Full screen, `min-h-screen`, black background.
- Include a fixed, full-screen background video (`https://cdn.midjourney.com/video/71048e88-d8e6-470e-88ef-555c01eacb12/0.mp4`) that is muted, looping, auto-playing, and scaled to 105%.
- Add a fixed overlay with 10% black opacity and `backdrop-blur-sm` to dim the background video.

### 2. Main Center Card
- Create a main container that sits above the background (`z-10`), flex row (column on mobile), max-width 1040px, min-height 650px.
- Background should be solid white, with a subtle gray border, heavy rounded corners (`rounded-[2.5rem]`), and a soft black drop shadow.

### 3. Left Side (Video Mask Area)
- Takes up 45% of the width.
- Background `#0c0c0e`, rounded corners (`rounded-[2rem]`), and `overflow-hidden`.
- Inside, place the exact same background video (`https://cdn.midjourney.com/video/71048e88-d8e6-470e-88ef-555c01eacb12/0.mp4`), fully visible (no dark overlays), absolute inset-0, covering the entire left container.

### 4. Right Side (Form Area)
- Takes up 55% of the width, padded generously.
- Include a decorative, absolutely positioned blurred circle in the top-left corner (`w-64 h-64 blur-[80px]`) using a sunset gradient (`#FF512F` to `#F09819`) at 20% opacity.
- **Header:** "Welcome back" (40px font size, semibold, tight tracking, dark text) and subtitle "Sign in to your account" (sm, gray-500). Center aligned.
- **Social Buttons:** Two full-width buttons ("Continue with Google" and "Continue with X"). Include SVGs for the logos. Style: Light gray background (`bg-gray-50`), gray border, `rounded-[1.25rem]`, padding 16px. Add a right-aligned ArrowRight icon that slightly darkens on hover.
- **Divider:** Flex row with "OR" text (10px, uppercase, wide tracking, gray-400) flanked by 1px horizontal lines that fade out to transparent at the edges.
- **Email Input Group:**
  - A container with `bg-gray-50`, gray border, `rounded-[1.25rem]`, padding 8px. Changes to white background and darker border on focus-within.
  - Left side: Stacked "Email" label (11px) and transparent text input ("Enter your email").
  - **Submit Button (CRITICAL):** On the right side, a circular button (52x52px). It must have a solid black fill. Around the button, create a bold, multi-colored border using a conic gradient (`#00c6ff, #0072ff, #ff007a, #ff8a00, #00c6ff`). 
  - **Button Interaction:** When hovering over the button, the conic-gradient border must continuously rotate (`animate-spin`), and an outer glowing blur of the exact same conic gradient should become fully visible and spin alongside it. The inner black button should have an inner shadow, and the white ArrowRight icon inside should translate slightly to the right (`translate-x-0.5`).
- **Footer:** "Don't have an account?" (gray-500) followed by a "Sign up" link where the text has a background clip with the sunset gradient (`from-[#FF512F] to-[#F09819]`). Center aligned at the bottom.

];

2. Custom Animation Component
Create a reusable <AnimatedText> component to handle a smooth word-by-word reveal effect.

CRITICAL: Iterate over the words using React.Fragment. Place the animated <span> containing the word, and follow it with a standard " " (space) if it's not the last word. Do NOT use whitespace-pre on the wrapper, as this breaks mobile text wrapping.

The inner wrapper must have max-w-[1440px] px-6 md:px-12 lg:px-24 pt-24 md:pt-32 pb-24.

title: Tenlas Footer
prompt:
Please create a single, fully responsive HTML file using Tailwind CSS that contains two main sections: a Call-to-Action (CTA) and a Footer. The design must precisely match the following specifications, including layout, typography, colors, and animations.

General Setup & Styling
Technology: Use HTML5 and the Tailwind CSS CDN via <script src="https://cdn.tailwindcss.com"></script>.
Font: Use the "Inter" font from Google Fonts (weights 400 through 900). Apply it globally to the body.
Icons: Include FontAwesome via CDN for social media icons (<script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/font-awesome/6.4.0/js/all.min.js"></script>).
Color Palette (Configure in Tailwind config):
Background (CTA): Off-white/light gray (#f5f5f2).
Footer Background: Almost black (#050505).
Brand Accent: Neon Yellow (#dbff00).
Muted Text (CTA): Gray (#6b7280).
Light Muted Text (Footer): Light gray (#9ca3af).
Animations:
Add custom CSS for smooth, staggered load animations.
Create a .fade-up class (starts with opacity 0, transforms Y by 20px). When a .visible class is added, it transitions to opacity 1 and transform Y 0 over 0.7s with a cubic-bezier easing.
Create delay classes (.delay-100 through .delay-500) to stagger the elements as they appear.
Ensure all hover effects on links and buttons are smooth (transition: color 0.3s ease, background-color 0.3s ease, transform 0.3s ease;).
Section 1: Call to Action (CTA)
Layout: Full width, centered content, minimum height of 50vh, significant top and bottom padding (py-20 md:py-32).
Background: Set the body background to the off-white color.
Heading:
Text: "Take control of your productivity today."
Base size: 18px (text-[18px]), scaling to 36px on md, and 48px on lg screens.
Style: Bold, black, tight tracking (tracking-tighter), tight line-height (leading-[1.1]).
Animation: Apply .fade-up.
Secondary Text:
Text: "Stay organized, focused, and on top of your tasks with Tenlas."
Base size: 14px (text-[14px]), scaling to 15px on md screens.
Style: Medium weight, muted text color.
Animation: Apply .fade-up and .delay-100.
Button:
Text: "Download now"
Style: Black background, neon yellow text (#dbff00), semi-bold, rounded corners (rounded-lg), small padding (px-6 py-2.5), text size sm to base.
Hover effect: Change background to a slightly lighter black (hover:bg-gray-900), add a shadow, and slightly translate upwards (hover:-translate-y-0.5).
Animation: Wrap the button in a div with .fade-up and .delay-200.
Section 2: Footer
Layout: Dark background (#050505), top padding (pt-16 md:pt-24), zero bottom padding (pb-0). The section must be relative and overflow-hidden.
Content Wrapper (Top Section): Max width 7xl, centered (mx-auto), standard side padding (px-6 md:px-20 lg:px-32). It should stack vertically on mobile and horizontally on large screens (flex-col lg:flex-row), with a large bottom margin (mb-16 md:mb-24).
Footer Left Column (Brand Info & Socials)
Width: Full width on mobile, 1/3 width on large screens (lg:w-1/3).
Animation: Apply .fade-up and .delay-300.
Logo & Brand Name:
Container: Flexbox, vertically centered, gap.
Logo SVG: Create a complex, 3-layered isometric diamond/geometric shape using SVG paths. The top layer should have fill-opacity="0.15", and all layers should use currentColor so it appears white. Ensure it has a slight scale-up hover effect.
Brand Name: "Tenlas", text white, size xl to 2xl, bold.
Tagline: "Unlock your productivity potential." in the light muted text color (text-gray-light), size sm to base.
Social Icons:
A row of 4 icons: Instagram, Facebook, a custom SVG for Dribbble/Globe, and a custom SVG for X (Twitter).
Style: Small white squares (w-8 h-8 bg-white), black icons, rounded corners.
Hover effect: Change background to light gray (hover:bg-gray-200) and translate upwards (hover:-translate-y-1).
Footer Right Column (Links Navigation)
Width: Full width on mobile, 2/3 width on large screens (lg:w-2/3).
Layout: CSS Grid. 2 columns on mobile, 4 columns on medium/large screens (grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4), with gap.
Animation: Apply .fade-up and .delay-400.
Links Configuration:
Column 1: Home V.1, Home V.2, Home V.3, Features.
Column 2: About, Pricing V.1, Pricing V.2, Pricing V.3.
Column 3: Blogs V.1, Blogs V.2, Blogs V.3, Blogs Post.
Column 4: Style Guide, Licensing, Changelog.
Link Styling: Light muted text color (text-gray-light), size sm.
Hover Effect: Smooth transition to solid white text (hover:text-white).
Footer Bottom: Massive "Tenlas" Text (Flawless Flush Alignment)
Layout: Centered at the very bottom.
Animation: Apply .fade-up and .delay-500.
CRITICAL ALIGNMENT INSTRUCTIONS: To ensure the massive text aligns perfectly flush with the left and right edges of the content above it across mobile, tablet, and desktop:
Container Wrapper: Create a wrapper div for this text that uses the exact same constraints as the top content section. It must have w-full max-w-7xl mx-auto and the exact same responsive side padding (px-6 md:px-20 lg:px-32).
Text Sizing (The SVG Trick): Because standard text sizes break when the max-w-7xl container stops growing on large desktops, do NOT use raw CSS font sizes. Instead, place an inline <svg> inside this container with viewBox="0 0 X Y" (calculate X and Y based on the font's bounding box) and width="100%". Inside the SVG, place a <text> element containing "Tenlas". This guarantees it will stretch edge-to-edge of its container perfectly without breaking on large screens.
Styling: Fill color: Neon yellow (#dbff00). Font: Bold.
Vertical Cutoff Fix: Add slight padding or translation so the rounded bottom edges of the letters aren't chopped off by the bottom of the screen.
Functionality
Include a small block of Vanilla JavaScript at the bottom of the body.
Use the IntersectionObserver API.
Select all elements with the .fade-up class.
When they enter the viewport (e.g., threshold: 0.1), add the .visible class to trigger the CSS transition.
Add a tiny setTimeout (50ms) to initialize the observer so the initial CTA content animates immediately upon page load.

title: Dark Neumorphic Project Setup Form
description: 3-step dark neumorphic form with icon picker, toggles, chip inputs, and animated transitions.
prompt:
Dark Neumorphic Multi-Step Project Creation Form
Build a centered, full-page dark neumorphic multi-step form. Base surface color is #1C1F26 for the page background and #22262F for the card. The shadow system uses two tones: dark #13151B and light #2D3240. Define three CSS variable shadow presets: --neu-raised (5px 5px 14px #13151B, -4px -4px 12px #2D3240), --neu-inset (inset 4px 4px 10px #13151B, inset -3px -3px 8px #2D3240), --neu-flat (2px 2px 5px each). Add a fixed radial gradient ambient glow behind the card: radial-gradient(ellipse, rgba(91,139,245,0.07) 0%, transparent 70%). Typography: Outfit (300–700) for UI, JetBrains Mono (400–500) for labels and slugs, from Google Fonts.
Step Indicator: An --neu-inset pill container holding 3 step nodes connected by thin divider lines. Complete steps show a green gradient circle with a checkmark; active step uses a blue gradient circle with colored drop shadow; pending steps use --neu-raised-sm with muted text. Steps animate state transitions via CSS class swaps.
Form Card: border-radius: 20px, --neu-raised, padding: 32px. Thin top edge highlight via ::before pseudo-element. Labels are 11.5px Outfit uppercase with 0.07em letter-spacing, color #8B95AB. Inputs use background: #1C1F26, --neu-inset shadow, border-radius: 12px. On focus: border: 1px solid rgba(91,139,245,0.4) plus box-shadow spread glow rgba(91,139,245,0.18). Select has a custom SVG chevron background-image.
Step 1 has a project name field with a slug preview strip (--neu-inset-sm, JetBrains Mono) that updates live via JS, a textarea, and a 2-column grid of selects. Step 2 has a color swatch picker (8 circular buttons with --neu-raised-sm, .selected shows white border ring), a 6-column icon grid (SVG icon buttons, --neu-raised-sm default, --neu-inset-sm selected), and two toggle switch rows. Toggles are custom CSS: --neu-inset track, circular thumb that slides with cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) spring easing, on-state uses blue accent glow. Step 3 has a chip input area (--neu-inset, chips styled background: rgba(91,139,245,0.08) with blue border), role select, and a toggle.
Actions row: Back button (--neu-raised-sm), Next/Submit (linear-gradient(145deg, #6B9BF5, #3A6CE8) with colored shadow). Submit goes green. A 3px --neu-inset progress bar fills via CSS width transition. On completion, panels are replaced with a centered success state featuring a circular inset icon wrap and a checkmark SVG. All panels animate in with translateX(12px) → 0 slide-in.

prompt:

Build a full-viewport sign-in screen with a warm, editorial light mode aesthetic. Use a 3-column CSS grid layout: two decorative outer columns and a centered auth card (480px wide). Background color #FAF7F2 (warm cream). Add two subtle radial gradient blobs in the background — a terracotta one at top-left and a warm brown one at bottom-right (both at ≤6% opacity) using position: fixed so they don't scroll.
Card: background: #FFFDF9, border: 1px solid #E8E0D4, border-radius: 2px (sharp corners), padding 52px/48px. Add a soft layered box-shadow with low opacity. Place a single horizontal gradient line across the top of the card using a pseudo-element: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, #C4714A, transparent), 1px tall, inset from sides.
Typography: Import Cormorant Garamond (300, 400, 500 + italic) and DM Sans (300, 400, 500) from Google Fonts. Card heading uses Cormorant Garamond 32px weight 400, color #2E2018. Labels use DM Sans 11px, letter-spacing 0.1em, uppercase, color #8B6F5E. Body/inputs use DM Sans 14px.
Inputs: Background #FAF7F2, border 1px solid #E8E0D4, border-radius 2px, padding 13px 16px. On focus: border becomes #C4714A with box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(196,113,74,0.08) and background shifts to #FFFDF9.
Primary button: Full-width, background: #2E2018, cream text, uppercase DM Sans 13px, letter-spacing 0.06em. On hover: background transitions to #C4714A with translateY(-1px).
Google button: Transparent with border: 1px solid #E8E0D4, hover shows #FAF7F2 fill.
Animations: All card children enter with staggered fadeUp (translateY 16px → 0, opacity 0 → 1) using animation-delay increments of 100ms. Left/right columns fade in from their respective sides. Use cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) easing for the card entrance.
Left column shows an italic Cormorant Garamond quote. Right column has a subtle 8-column dot grid (3px dots, color #E8E0D4) and two lines of small muted text. Fully responsive: hide side columns below 900px.

title: Navbar with Animated Mega Menu
description: A sticky frosted glass navbar with hover-triggered mega menu, category grid and simple dropdowns
prompt:
Create a sticky top navigation bar with a mega menu dropdown. Design:

NAVBAR: Frosted glass background (white 92% opacity + backdrop blur), 64px height, bottom border. Left: serif logo with italic pink accent. Center: navigation items with chevron arrows. Right: ghost sign-in button + dark pill CTA that turns pink on hover.

MEGA MENU (triggered on hover): Floats below the nav with 20px gap, white background, 20px border radius, heavy box shadow. Contains:
- 3-column grid of menu items, each with a rounded icon tile (emoji), bold title and muted description
- Featured item has pink-pale background and pink title with a "NEW" badge chip
- A horizontal divider
- Footer row: left shows item count, right shows "View all →" pink link
The menu animates in with opacity + translateY transition (0.25s ease).

SIMPLE DROPDOWN: A smaller white card dropdown for secondary nav items with icon + label rows that highlight on hover.

PAGE BELOW NAV: A centered hero with a large serif heading, subtitle, and a row of category pill filters (active = pink pale background).

Add a hint tooltip at the bottom explaining to hover the nav item.
Typography: Familjen Grotesk for logo and headings, Nunito for nav items.
Color palette: Background #f5f2ed, surface white, accent #e8007a.

title: Warm Editorial Auth
description: Soft cream, serif-driven sign-in screen with warm minimal SaaS polish.
prompt:
Design a warm minimal light-mode authentication screen with a refined, editorial SaaS aesthetic.
Use a full-page layout with a soft cream background #FAF7F2 layered with subtle radial gradients (#F3EDE5 and #F1E7DA) to create warmth and depth. Center a large rounded container (24px radius) with white background #FFFFFF and soft shadow 0 20px 50px rgba(30,20,10,0.08).
Split the container into two columns using CSS Grid (1.1fr / 0.9fr). The left panel should have generous padding (80px) and include:
A serif logo in Playfair Display
Large editorial headline (46px, line-height 1.1)
Supporting paragraph in muted brown-gray #6B625A
The right panel should contain a minimal sign-in form:
Title “Sign in” (22px, semi-bold)
Labeled inputs with 12px rounded corners
Border color #EFE8DF
On focus: border #D6A77A and subtle glow rgba(214,167,122,0.15)
Primary button with background #D6A77A, hover state #C79263, slight lift (translateY(-2px)) and soft shadow
Use DM Sans for all UI text. Add a fade-up entrance animation (opacity 0 → 1, translateY 20px → 0 over 0.9s). Include subtle underline hover animation for the secondary link.
The final result should feel calm, warm, and premium — like a funded productivity startup.

title: Brutalist Glass Navbar
description: Floating glass navigation bar with bold gradient accents and dark brutalist energy.
prompt:
Design a brutalist-modern glassmorphism dark-mode navbar for a high-end SaaS product.
Use a deep black background #0B0B0F layered with subtle radial gradients (#141421, #10101A) to create depth. The navbar should float centered at the top with 40px top padding and a max width of 1200px.
Apply strong glassmorphism:
Background: rgba(255,255,255,0.06)
Backdrop blur: blur(18px)
Border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.18)
Large rounded corners (18px)
Heavy shadow: 0 20px 60px rgba(0,0,0,0.6)
Typography:
Logo & nav: Space Grotesk
Secondary mono label: IBM Plex Mono
Use bold uppercase logo with accent color #7C5CFF
Accent gradient: #7C5CFF → #00E0FF
Navigation links (14px) should be muted gray #9CA0AA and animate on hover with a gradient underline using a pseudo-element width transition.
Include:
Outline button (transparent with subtle hover background)
Primary CTA button with gradient background and hover lift (-3px) + stronger shadow
Add a fade-down entrance animation (opacity 0 → 1, translateY -20px → 0). Include a thick brutalist gradient divider line below the navbar.
The design should feel bold, architectural, and futuristic — not soft or minimal.

title: Warm Minimal SaaS Landing Hero
description: A clean serif hero with app preview window, floating prompt bubble, social proof and tools row
prompt:
Create a warm minimal SaaS landing page hero section with the following design:

NAVBAR: Fixed top bar with backdrop blur, serif logo with italic pink accent, centered navigation links, ghost sign-in button and a dark pill-shaped CTA button that turns pink on hover.

HERO CENTER (full viewport height, centered):
- Announcement badge: pill shape with a filled pink "NEW" chip and text, white background with shadow
- Large serif heading (Instrument Serif, 88px) with one word in italic pink with a subtle pink underline gradient
- Subtitle in muted warm gray, max 520px wide
- Two CTA buttons side by side: primary filled pink with glow shadow, secondary outline that gets a pink border on hover
- Social proof row: 5 overlapping colored avatar circles + star rating + "Loved by 500+ vibe coders" text

APP PREVIEW WINDOW: A realistic browser mockup with:
- Window chrome bar with red/yellow/green dots and a URL bar showing the site name
- Split layout inside: left sidebar with category nav items (active item is white card with pink text), right area with filter pills and a 3-column mini card grid with gradient image areas
- A floating dark chat bubble in bottom-right corner showing a "Copied prompt" label in pink and sample prompt text

TOOLS ROW: "Works with" label followed by pill chips for Claude, v0, Lovable, Cursor, Bolt

Background: Near-white warm #fdfcfa with a large centered pink radial glow behind the heading. Subtle grain texture overlay at low opacity.
Typography: Instrument Serif for headings, Manrope for all other text.
Add staggered fade-up entrance animations with 0.1s delays between each element.
Color palette: Background #fdfcfa, accent #e8007a, text #1a1714, muted #7a7570.

title: Warm Minimal Button System
description: Editorial dark button components with warm tones and premium hover states.
prompt:
Design a warm minimal dark-mode button system for a premium SaaS interface.
Use a deep brown-black background #141210 with subtle radial gradients (#1F1B17, #1A1613) to create warmth. Center a large rounded container (28px radius) with background #1C1916, border 1px solid #2A2622, and shadow 0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,0.45).
Typography:
Headings: Fraunces serif, 44px, slightly tight letter-spacing
UI text: Plus Jakarta Sans, 14–16px
Create structured sections with small uppercase labels (14px, letter-spacing 1px, color #B7ADA3).
Buttons to include:
Primary Button
Background #C67C4E
Hover #D0895C
White text
Shadow 0 10px 30px rgba(198,124,78,0.35)
On hover: translateY(-2px) + stronger shadow
Pill Gradient Button
Border-radius 999px
Linear gradient (135deg) #C67C4E → #A8663C
Larger hover lift (-3px)
Secondary Button
Background #221F1B
Border #2A2622
Subtle hover darkening
Ghost Button
Transparent background
Text #B7ADA3
On hover: text becomes #F5F1EA
Animated underline using pseudo-element width transition
Icon Button
Square shape with rounded corners (12px)
Add a fade-up entrance animation (opacity 0 → 1, translateY 30px → 0 over 0.9s). All buttons should have 14px border radius (except pill), smooth 0.25s transitions, and subtle vertical lift on hover.
The design should feel refined, warm, and intentional — like a modern productivity startup.

title: Warm Focus Dashboard
description: A refined light-mode productivity dashboard with warm editorial styling and tactile data cards.
prompt:
Create a premium desktop analytics dashboard in a warm minimal light mode aesthetic that feels like a boutique productivity tool rather than a traditional enterprise dashboard. Use a soft ivory background (#F6F1E8) with layered cream surfaces (#FBF8F4), warm beige accents (#E9D8C5), muted borders (#E7DDD0), and a rich terracotta accent (#C88754). Primary text should use #302A24 with secondary text #857868.

Typography should combine Cormorant Garamond for large editorial headings and Manrope for all interface elements, metrics, labels, and buttons. The overall feeling should be calm, elegant, and tactile.

The layout consists of a rounded left navigation sidebar, a spacious top header, a large hero analytics card, three metric cards, and a right column containing a task list and compact calendar. Every surface should have generous padding (24–34px), large border radii (20–28px), subtle 1px borders, and soft layered shadows using low-opacity black.

The hero card contains a large editorial headline, supporting copy, and a circular conic-gradient progress visualization showing 72%. Metric cards display bold numbers with abstract sparkline-style graphics created using CSS clip-path and gradients instead of SVG.

Buttons should be pill-shaped with soft shadows. Navigation items slide slightly right on hover. Cards lift upward by 6px during hover. Calendar cells gently scale on hover, while the active date uses the terracotta accent. Include a fade-up page entrance animation, subtle radial background gradients, and a slow rotating conic progress ring to create gentle motion without distracting from the minimalist aesthetic.

title: Editorial Magazine-Style Blog Layout
description: A newspaper-inspired layout with masthead, featured article, 2x2 article grid and sidebar
prompt:
Create a light mode editorial blog layout with a newspaper/magazine aesthetic using warm off-white tones.

TOP BANNER: Full-width dark ink bar with a pink accent announcement text and uppercase letter-spacing.

HEADER: Three-row structure:
- Top row: date left, large Playfair Display 900-weight masthead centered with italic pink word, subscribe + sign-in buttons right
- Nav row: centered uppercase Barlow links separated by dots, active link in pink
- Both rows separated by thin borders, bottom has a 2px solid ink border

MAIN LAYOUT: 2-column grid (article content left, sidebar right 280px) with 60px padding.

FEATURED ARTICLE: Category tag in pink uppercase, a tall dark gradient image area (ink + pink glow + purple glow) with a caption overlay, large 38px serif headline with italic pink word, lead paragraph in light weight, author avatar + name + date + read time row.

ARTICLE GRID: 2x2 grid of smaller article cards each with a colorful gradient image, pink category label, serif title that turns pink on hover, excerpt, and date.

SIDEBAR: Dark ink newsletter signup box (serif italic heading, email input, pink submit button), trending articles list with large faded number labels, tag cloud with hover-pink pills.

Typography: Playfair Display for all headings, Barlow for labels/UI, Source Serif 4 for body text.
Color palette: Background #faf7f2, ink #1a1410, accent #e8007a, warm surface #f2ede5.

title: Warm Colorful Feature Card System
description: 6-color card library with decorative headers, metric cards, and a wide featured highlight panel.
prompt:
Warm Minimal Colorful Card System — Light Mode
Build a full card showcase page on a warm cream background #FAF8F4. Card surfaces use #FFFDF9 with border: 1px solid #EDE8E0 and border-radius: 16px. Typography uses Fraunces (serif, 300–600 + italic) for headings and numbers, and Instrument Sans (400–600) for body text — both from Google Fonts. Heading color is #1A1209, body text #4A3F30, muted text #8C7D6B.
Define 6 semantic color palettes, each with a full, background, and mid-tone: Terracotta (#D4654A / #FDF0EC / #F5C4B5), Saffron (#E8913A / #FEF4E8 / #F8D4A3), Sage (#4A8B6F / #EDF5F1 / #B3D8C6), Cobalt (#3A5FC4 / #EDF1FB / #B3C3EE), Plum (#8B4F7A / #F6EFF4 / #D9B8D3), Olive (#6B7A2A / #F3F5E8 / #CEDA96).
Feature Cards (3-column grid): Each card has a 140px colored header area using the card's background tone, with two decorative ::before/::after absolutely-positioned blurred circles using the mid-tone and full color at low opacity — creating soft depth. A colored icon button (38×38px, 10px radius, matching accent color, white SVG icon, soft box-shadow) sits anchored to the bottom-left of the header. Card body has a 10px uppercase tag in accent color, a Fraunces 18px title, 13px body text, and a footer divider with a small meta label and an animated arrow link (gap increases on hover).
Metric Cards (2-column grid): Each has an 88px colored accent column housing a centered icon, and a body area with a Fraunces 28px number, label, a 4px progress bar (filled with accent color), and a caption. Cards enter with staggered fadeUp animations (translateY 18px → 0) at 70ms delay increments starting at 150ms.
Wide Featured Card: Two-column layout — left has a badge pill with icon, Fraunces 30px italic-accented title, body text, and a dark CTA button that turns terracotta on hover. Right side uses saffron background with ::before and ::after circle decorations, and three frosted stat rows (background: rgba(255,255,255,0.85), backdrop-filter: blur(8px), border, 12px radius) that slide left on hover. Cards lift on hover via translateY(-3px) and a deeper box-shadow.

title: Dark Command Palette with Keyboard Navigation
description: A ⌘K spotlight-style command palette over a blurred app background with sections and keyboard hints
prompt:
Create a dark command palette UI (⌘K style) overlaid on a blurred app background. Design:

BACKGROUND: Deep dark #080810 with an animated subtle grid pattern (pink tinted, slow opacity pulse). Three blurred ambient orbs (pink top-left, cyan bottom-right, purple center-right). A blurred, dimmed app shell (window chrome, sidebar, content lines) is visible behind the palette at low opacity.

⌘K HINT: Small row above palette showing keyboard shortcut chips (⌘ + K) with a label.

COMMAND PALETTE (620px wide, centered):
- Container: near-black surface with a pink-tinted outer glow, subtle border, heavy drop shadow, 16px radius
- SEARCH BAR: Row with a pink glowing ⌘ icon, a monospace text input showing partial query with an animated blinking pink cursor, result count badge in pink
- SECTIONS separated by thin dividers, each with an uppercase 9px label:
  - " Prompts": 3 results with icon tiles (colored bg), bold title with highlighted match text in pink, muted subtitle with view/copy stats, right-side premium/free tag badge
  - " Quick Actions": 2 action items with amber/pink tags
  - " Navigation": 2 page links with blue tags
- ACTIVE ITEM: Left pink border with glow, slightly lighter background, "open ↵" hint appears on right
- FOOTER: Left side keyboard hint chips (↑↓ navigate, ↵ open, esc close), right side "powered by" brand text

Typography: IBM Plex Mono throughout for the terminal/developer feel.
Color palette: Background #080810, surface #0e0e1a, pink #ff2d78, cyan #00f5cc, purple #b45aff.
Add a scale+translateY entrance animation and blinking cursor animation.
The overall feel: Linear/Raycast-inspired, keyboard-first, developer-tool premium.

title: Light Mode User Profile Card Grid
description: A warm off-white card gallery with gradient preview thumbnails, role badges, and copy prompt buttons
prompt:
Create a light mode card gallery page for user profile cards with the following design:

LAYOUT: A full page with a warm off-white background (#f7f5f2) with a subtle dot-grid pattern. Include a page header with a serif + italic heading, a horizontal filter pill row, and a responsive 3-column card grid where the first card spans 2 columns as a featured item.

EACH CARD should have:
- A colorful gradient image area (soft pastel gradients like peach, sky blue, lime-green, pink-purple) with a floating frosted glass mini-UI preview inside showing an avatar, name skeleton lines, a role badge, and a small stats row
- A card body with a pink category label, AI tool tags, a serif title, short description, view/copy stats, and a pill-shaped "Copy prompt" button that fills pink on hover
- Premium cards show a " Premium" badge overlay on the image area
- Smooth lift + shadow on hover with a subtle pink border tint

FILTER PILLS: Rounded pill buttons — active state fills pink with a soft glow shadow, inactive has a white background with border.

PAGE HEADER: Left side has a Playfair Display serif heading with one word in italic pink, right side has a "View all →" link underlined in pink.

Color palette: Background #f7f5f2, cards white, accent #e8007a, muted #888880, borders rgba(0,0,0,0.07).
Typography: Playfair Display for headings, Outfit for body text.
Add staggered fade-up entrance animations on load for each card.

title: Dark Split Auth Screen with Glassmorphism
description: A two-panel sign in page with animated background grid, glow orbs, and an example prompt preview card
prompt:
Create a dark split-panel authentication screen with the following design:

LEFT PANEL — dark background (#0a0a0f) with a subtle animated dot/line grid overlay and two soft glow orbs (pink and purple) in opposite corners. Include:
- A top-left brand logo in bold white with a pink accent color
- A large heading with one word highlighted in bright pink (#e8007a)
- 3 feature bullet points with pink glowing dots
- A bottom preview card with frosted glass effect showing a sample prompt text

RIGHT PANEL — slightly lighter dark surface with:
- A pill-shaped tab switcher between "Sign in" and "Create account" with the active tab filled in bright pink
- Form title and subtitle text
- Email and password input fields with dark backgrounds, subtle borders, and a pink glow on focus
- A full-width primary button in bright pink with a shine overlay and lift effect on hover
- An "or continue with" divider with lines on each side
- A Google sign-in button with transparent background and subtle border
- A footer note with a pink link

Typography: Use a bold geometric display font (like Syne) for headings and a clean sans-serif (like DM Sans) for body text.

Color palette: Background #0a0a0f, surface #111118, accent #e8007a, muted text #6b6b80, borders rgba(255,255,255,0.07).

Add a smooth slide-up entrance animation on page load for the card. The overall feel should be premium, modern, and developer-focused.

title: Neumorphic Workspace Card Collection
description: Complete SaaS workspace card system — project tracker, roadmap timeline, team roster, and integrations.
prompt:
Neumorphic Workspace Card System — Professional Light Mode
Build a full-page SaaS workspace card showcase. The entire page — background, all card surfaces, inputs, tiles — shares a single base color: #E2E6EC. Light shadow is #FFFFFF, dark shadow is #B8BDC6. Define four CSS shadow presets: --raised (8px 8px 20px #B8BDC6, -6px -6px 16px #FFFFFF), --raised-sm, --raised-xs, and --inset (inset 4px 4px 10px #B8BDC6, inset -4px -4px 10px #FFFFFF). Typography: DM Serif Display (regular + italic) for all headings and large numbers, Geist (300–600) for body, from Google Fonts.
Layout: Three vertical sections with 18px gutters. Section 1 is a 3-column bento grid: (A) a tall project card with a colored gradient hero (linear-gradient(145deg, #4A62D8, #7254C8, #C4517A)), overlapping white circle blobs at low opacity, a frosted glass badge, a progress bar using --inset track and gradient fill, and a member avatar stack with --bg-bordered circles; (B) a center column stacking 3 stat tiles (each with --raised-sm, inset icon badge, DM Serif 26px value, trend pill) and a full task list card with neumorphic checkboxes (empty = --raised-xs, done = --inset-sm + teal pseudo-element checkmark); (C) a compact team roster card with member rows showing --inset-sm on hover, 32px gradient avatars with colored online/away/offline status dots, and hours badges using --raised-xs.
Section 2: Wide roadmap timeline card with month columns, an absolutely-positioned today marker (rose color, glow shadow, labeled chip), and horizontally-positioned gradient bar segments using left and width percentages. Bars use --inset tracks. Section 3: Two-column row — an 8-cell integration grid (4×2, each tile uses --raised-sm default and --inset-sm for connected state, with a colored status dot) and an invite card featuring an inset email input, blue gradient submit button with colored drop shadow, and pending invitation rows using --raised-xs + resend links. All cards animate in with staggered fadeUp at 100ms increments.

title: Glassmorphism Card System Pro
description: Full card library on a gradient mesh background — frosted profiles, metrics, activity feed, and pricing.
prompt:
Minimal Glassmorphism Card System — Professional Light Mode
Build a full-page card showcase on a radial gradient mesh background. Base color is #EEF2FA with five overlapping radial gradients using position: fixed: periwinkle #C7D9F5 at top-left, blush #F5D0E8 at top-right, mint #C8EDE3 at bottom-right, lavender #EDE8FA at bottom-left, and peach #FDECD3 at center. Add a faint SVG noise texture overlay at 3% opacity for tactile depth.
Glass card base: background: rgba(255,255,255,0.55), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.75), border-radius: 20px, backdrop-filter: blur(20px). Box-shadow uses a 3-layer stack: inner top highlight 0 1px 0 rgba(255,255,255,0.9) inset, ambient spread 0 4px 24px rgba(100,110,160,0.12), and a fine edge shadow. On hover, background shifts to rgba(255,255,255,0.72), shadow deepens, and translateY(-2px). Import Bricolage Grotesque (300–700) and Literata (italic 300–400) from Google Fonts.
Three grid rows: (1) 3-column profile card with avatar (52px circle with white ring border), stat strip using nested frosted mini-tiles rgba(255,255,255,0.5), and tag pills — plus two metric cards with colored icon wraps, 34px bold values, trend badges, and SVG sparklines with gradient fills. (2) 2-column row: an activity feed with avatar rows that reveal rgba(255,255,255,0.55) backgrounds on hover, status badges with soft tinted backgrounds, and a donut card using SVG stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset with a centered percentage overlay. (3) 3-column pricing cards, with the center "featured" card using a blue tint background rgba(75,111,212,0.10) and a gradient border-radius: 0 0 10px 10px label strip at the top. CTA buttons: ghost style uses rgba(255,255,255,0.55) frosted background; filled uses linear-gradient(135deg, #5B85E0, #7254C8) with colored drop shadow.
All grid children enter with staggered fadeUp animations (translateY 20px → 0, opacity 0 → 1) using cubic-bezier(0.22, 1, 0.36, 1) and 80ms delay increments per card.

title: Neumorphic Pro Button System
description: Complete soft-UI button library with raised, inset, filled, and semantic variants on a cool grey base.
prompt:
Neumorphic Button System — Light Mode
Build a comprehensive button component showcase page using a refined neumorphism aesthetic. Page background and all button surfaces share the same base color: #E8EDF2 (cool blue-grey). Typography uses Sora (weights 300–600) for UI text and JetBrains Mono for section labels/eyebrows — both imported from Google Fonts.
Core neumorphic shadow system — define three CSS variable presets: raised (6px 6px 14px #C5CDD8, -6px -6px 14px #FFFFFF), inset (inset 4px 4px 10px #C5CDD8, inset -4px -4px 10px #FFFFFF), and flat (3px 3px 8px #C5CDD8, -3px -3px 8px #FFFFFF). Every button uses one of these three states. On :hover, raised buttons increase shadow radius by ~30% and translateY(-1px). On :active, buttons switch to the inset shadow with transform: none.
Variants: Primary (raised, accent blue text #4A7CF7), Filled (blue gradient linear-gradient(145deg, #5B8AF8, #3A6CE8) with white text and a matching colored drop shadow), Ghost (no shadow by default, flat on hover), Inset (permanently pressed), Semantic colors (green #38B2AC, rose #F56565, amber #ED8936) all using raised state with colored text. Disabled (60% opacity, pointer-events none). Loading (inset state with a spinning ::after pseudo-element border-top accent).
Sizes: Small (9px/20px padding, 10px radius), Medium (13px/28px, 14px radius), Large (17px/36px, 18px radius). Pill variant uses border-radius: 999px. Icon-only buttons are 46×46px squares or circles.
Toggle group: Buttons share the same container; JS removes .active class from siblings and adds to clicked element. Active state uses inset shadow + accent blue text. CTA row: Two-column grid — one neumorphic raised, one gradient filled, both full-width with 18px padding and 18px radius.
Page structure: Vertical stack of labeled sections. Section labels use JetBrains Mono 10.5px uppercase with a gradient divider line extending to the right via ::after pseudo-element. All sections animate in with staggered fadeUp (translateY 20px → 0) using increasing animation-delay values of 100ms each.

title: Warm Light Mode Kanban Project Board
description: A 4-column kanban with draggable cards, priority dots, progress bars and assignee avatars
prompt:
Create a light mode kanban board with a warm, professional aesthetic.

TOPBAR: White surface bar with logo, breadcrumb trail (Projects › Sprint › Board), filter/group buttons, stacked avatar row of team members, and a pink "New task" button.

4 COLUMNS side by side (each 280px wide, full viewport height):
- To Do: warm beige background (#f5f2ec)
- In Progress: warm yellow-white (#fffaf0)
- In Review: soft purple-white (#f8f0ff)
- Done: soft green-white (#f0fdf6)

Each column has: colored dot + title + count badge + add button in header.

CARDS (white, 10px radius, 1px border):
- Category label pill (feature=purple, bug=red, design=pink, content=amber, infra=blue)
- Priority dot (high=red, med=amber, low=gray) in top-right
- Bold title in Bricolage Grotesque
- Optional progress bar (thin 3px track with colored gradient fill)
- Footer: stacked assignee avatars + meta (comments count, date)
- On hover: card lifts with shadow + slight rotation + pink border tint
- "Dragging" state card has stronger shadow, pink border, more rotation

Cards in Done column are 75% opacity with strikethrough titles.
"+ Add task" dashed border button at bottom of each column, turns pink on hover.

Typography: Bricolage Grotesque 800 for titles, Mulish for body text.
Color palette: Background #f0ece4, surface white, accent #e8007a.
Add staggered fade-up animations per column on load.

title: Two-Column Checkout Form with Order Summary
description: A split checkout layout with contact info, card payment, promo code and live order summary
prompt:
Create a light mode checkout page with a 2-column layout (form left, summary right) on a warm beige background.

LEFT PANEL (white card, 20px radius):
Divided into numbered sections with a serif section title and step number circle (done=green, active=pink):

Section 1 — Contact Info: First name, last name, email in a 2-column grid. Completed fields have green border and green checkmark icon inside. A " Saved" label appears in the header.

Section 2 — Payment: Three payment method tiles (Card, PayPal, Apple Pay) — selected tile has pink border and pink-pale background. Card number input has a card emoji prefix icon. Expiry, CVV, and name on card fields below in a 2-column grid.

RIGHT COLUMN (stacked cards):
1. Order Summary card: Product row with gradient pink-purple icon tile, product name, description, and price. Line items (subtotal, discount in green, tax). Bold total row with pink price.
2. Promo Code card: Small input + Apply button. Shows applied code and savings in green.
3. Pay Button card: Full-width pink pay button with lock icon, glow shadow and lift on hover. Trust badges row below (SSL, refund, global).

Typography: Lora serif for titles and prices, DM Sans for all form elements.

title: Neumorphic Analytics Dashboard Pro
description: Full SaaS analytics dashboard with neumorphic cards, live activity feed, bar chart, and donut widget.
prompt:
Neumorphic SaaS Analytics Dashboard — Light Mode
Build a full-viewport SaaS analytics dashboard using a refined neumorphism aesthetic. Use a two-column CSS grid layout: a fixed 220px sidebar and a scrollable main content area. The base surface color for every element — background, cards, buttons, inputs — is the same #E4E9F0 (cool blue-grey). Light shadow is #FFFFFF, dark shadow is #BDC5D1. Define three CSS variable shadow presets: --neu-raised (6px 6px 16px #BDC5D1, -6px -6px 16px #FFFFFF), --neu-inset (inset 4px 4px 10px #BDC5D1, inset -4px -4px 10px #FFFFFF), --neu-flat (2px 2px 6px #BDC5D1, -2px -2px 6px #FFFFFF). Import Plus Jakarta Sans (300–700) and JetBrains Mono (400–500) from Google Fonts.
Sidebar: Sticky, full-height, 220px wide with 28px/20px padding. Logo uses a blue gradient icon (linear-gradient(145deg, #5B8AF8, #3A6CE8)) with colored drop shadow. Nav items are 13px Plus Jakarta Sans weight 500, border-radius: 12px. Active state uses --neu-inset shadow with #4B7CF7 text. Hover uses --neu-flat. Section labels in JetBrains Mono 10px uppercase. Bottom user card uses --neu-raised-sm. Sidebar fades in on load.
Stat Cards: 4-column grid, border-radius: 20px, --neu-raised shadow. Each card contains: a colored icon wrap (12px radius, --neu-inset-sm) with a semantic accent color, a trend badge (green #34C48A or rose #F56E6E) with up/down arrow SVG, a large 28px bold value, a 12px muted label, and an inline SVG sparkline with a linear gradient fill at 12% opacity. Cards animate in with staggered fadeUp (18px translateY) at 80ms delay increments starting at 200ms.
Bar Chart Card: Full-width, inset chart area (--neu-inset, border-radius: 14px). Paired bars per month — primary bars use blue gradient (linear-gradient(180deg, #5B8AF8, #3A6CE8)) with colored drop shadow; secondary bars are #b0c4f8 at 70% opacity. Bars grow from bottom using scaleY keyframe animation with staggered delays. A repeating horizontal gradient grid line provides Y-axis context.
Right Column (340px): Stacked activity feed card (live transactions with colored dot indicators, mono amounts) and a traffic donut card. Donut is an SVG circle set using stroke-dasharray/stroke-dashoffset, wrapped in an --neu-inset circular container. Legend uses 10px rounded swatches. All cards enter with staggered fadeUp animations between 500–700ms delay.
Top bar: Flex row with page title (24px bold, −0.025em tracking) and action buttons using --neu-raised-sm. Primary export button uses the blue gradient fill. Date range pill group below uses --neu-flat default and --neu-inset-sm active state — clicking a pill updates active class via JavaScript.
